structural_source.notice:
# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

translation.text: Frostbitten feet. Formed from 足, with 囷 indicating the sound.
Amputation of a foot, 跀. Formed from 足, with 非 indicating the sound. Read like 匪.
That which the feet tread upon. Formed from 足, with 叚 indicating the sound.
To jump. Formed from 足, with 䍃 indicating the sound.
To tread or step, especially in the historical expression for wading through blood that stains the feet. Formed from 足, with 執 indicating the sound.

caseEvidence.reviewerNote: Duan explicitly equates 䠟 with 蹀 and cites ancient expression 喋血. Replaces vague “feet drawn together”.

translation.text: 歭䠧: not to advance. Formed from 足, with 屠 indicating the sound.
A place trodden upon. Formed from 足, with abbreviated 斷 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 弓弩發於身而中於遠也。从矢从身。

translation.text: A bow or crossbow discharging from near the body and hitting at a distance. From 矢 and 身.

entries.text: 車約䡅也。从車川聲。《周禮》曰：“孤乘夏䡅。”一曰下棺車曰䡅。

translation.text: A carriage's binding or ornament, apparently. Formed from 車, with 川 indicating the sound. The Rites of Zhou says: “A senior dignitary (孤) rides a 夏䡅 carriage.” Alternatively, a carriage for lowering a coffin is called 䡅.

entries.text: 車轅耑持衡者。从車元聲。

translation.text: What holds the crossbar at the end of a carriage shaft. Formed from 車, with 元 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 車騎上曲銅也。从車爻聲。

translation.text: A curved bronze fitting above the carriage's 騎 component; its precise position is unclear. Formed from 車, with 爻 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 車耳反出也。从車从反，反亦聲。

translation.text: A carriage's side projections turned outward. Formed from 車 and 反; 反 also indicates the sound.

entries.text: 車搖也。从車从行。一曰衍省聲。

translation.text: A carriage shaking. Formed from 車 and 行. Alternatively, abbreviated 衍 indicates the sound.
To obstruct. Formed from 車, with 多 indicating the sound.
A weight at the rear of a large carriage. Formed from 車, with 宛 indicating the sound.
The 纩 fitting of a straight-shafted carriage; the technical term is unclear. Formed from 車, with 具 indicating the sound.
The curved fitting of a yoke. Formed from 車, with 軍 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 車䡩𨥺也。从車眞聲。讀若《論語》“鏗尔，舍瑟而作”。又讀若掔。

translation.text: The carriage fitting or sound called 䡩𨥺; the technical sense is unclear. Formed from 車, with 眞 indicating the sound. Read like 鏗 in the Analects' 'With a clang he set aside his zither and rose'; also read like 掔.
The cover of a covered carriage. Formed from 車, with 曼 indicating the sound.
A carriage being sturdy. Formed from 車, with 殸 indicating the sound.
A carriage for breaking battle formations. Formed from 車, with 童 indicating the sound.
The appearance of a high load. Formed from 車, with abbreviated 𣡌 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 治也。从辟乂聲。《虞書》曰：“有能俾䢃。”

translation.text: To govern. Formed from 辟, with 乂 indicating the sound. The Book of Yu says: “Is there someone who can bring order?”

entries.text: 早昧爽也。从𦥑从辰。辰，時也。辰亦聲。𠃨夕爲𡖊，臼辰爲䢅，皆同意。凡䢅之屬皆从䢅。

translation.text: Early dawn, when dimness clears. Formed from 𦥑 and 辰; 辰 means time and also indicates the sound. 𠃨 with 夕 makes 𡖊; 臼 with 辰 makes 䢅, both sharing the same idea. All characters in the 䢅 category are formed from 䢅.

caseEvidence.reviewerNote: Duan confirms early daybreak and 會意 analysis; original wording adequate.

entries.text: 日月合宿从辰。从會从辰，辰亦聲。

translation.text: The sun and moon sharing a lodge and following the celestial station. Formed from 會 and 辰, with 辰 also indicating the sound. [The clause 合宿从辰 is uncertain.]
To plow. Formed from 䢅, with 囟 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 古之遒人，以木鐸記詩言。从辵从丌，丌亦聲。讀與記同。

translation.text: The ancient herald who used a wooden-clapper bell to record poems and words. Formed from 辵 and 丌, with 丌 also indicating the sound. Pronounced the same as 記.
A manner of walking. Formed from 辵, with 巿 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 前頡也。从辵巿聲。賈侍中說：一讀若㭘，又若郅。

translation.text: To move forward with the face or head thrust out, as in a particular way of running or moving. Formed from 辵, with 巿 indicating the sound. Palace Attendant Jia offers readings like 㭘 or 郅. [Duan discusses a competing graph and the gloss 䢡走也.]

caseEvidence.reviewerNote: Duan notes variant glyph and interpretation; preserve uncertainty, avoid confident body posture.

translation.text: To go. Formed from 辵, with 且 indicating the sound. 䢐 is a word of Qi.
To refuse angrily to advance. Formed from 辵, with 氐 indicating the sound.
To meet or assemble. Formed from 辵, with 交 indicating the sound.
To reach or catch up with, the same as 遝. Formed from 辵, with 合 indicating the sound.

caseEvidence.reviewerNote: Duan cross-ref and 广韵 define 遝行相及, supporting overtaking rather than merely meeting.

entries.text: 𣀩也。从辵貝聲。《周書》曰：“我興受其䢙。”

translation.text: To defeat or ruin, 𣀩. Formed from 辵, with 貝 indicating the sound. The Book of Zhou says: “We rise to receive its defeat.”

caseEvidence.reviewerNote: Duan explicitly equates with 敗: to ruin or destroy; original English is accurate.

translation.text: To guide in front. Formed from 辵, with 率 indicating the sound.
To obstruct, 遮䢭. Formed from 辵, with 羨 indicating the sound.
Familiarity bordering on disrespect, 媟䢱. Formed from 辵, with 𧷏 indicating the sound.
A place name. Formed from 邑, with 几 indicating the sound.
A township in Hu, Right Fufeng. Formed from 邑, with 且 indicating the sound.
A place name. Formed from 邑, with 臣 indicating the sound.
A pavilion in Wuyin, Nanyang. Formed from 邑, with 羽 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 今桂陽䣂陽縣。从邑耒聲。

translation.text: The present 䣂陽 County in Guiyang. Formed from 邑, with 耒 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 邾下邑地。从邑余聲。魯東有䣄城。讀若塗。

translation.text: A lower settlement of Zhu. Formed from 邑, with 余 indicating the sound. East of Lu is 䣄 City. Read like 塗.
A place name. Formed from 邑, with 求 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 周公所誅䣍國。在魯。从邑奄聲。

translation.text: The state of 䣍, punished by the Duke of Zhou, in Lu. Formed from 邑, with 奄 indicating the sound.
存䣕, a county in Jianwei. Formed from 邑, with 馬 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 右扶風鄠鄉。从邑崩聲。沛城父有䣙鄉。讀若陪。

translation.text: A township in Hu, Right Fufeng. Formed from 邑, with 崩 indicating the sound. Chengfu in Pei also has a 䣙 Township. Read like 陪.
A township in Rang, Nanyang. Formed from 邑, with 婁 indicating the sound.
A place in Qi. Formed from 邑, with 桼 indicating the sound.
A county in Pei state. Formed from 邑, with 虘 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 左馮翊䣝陽亭。从邑屠聲。

translation.text: 䣝陽 Pavilion in Left Fengyi. Formed from 邑, with 屠 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 臨淮徐地。从邑義聲。《春秋傳》曰：“徐䣡楚。”

translation.text: A place in Xu, Linhuai. Formed from 邑, with 義 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “Xu 䣡 Chu”; the wording is uncertain.
A place in Shu. Formed from 邑, with 耤 indicating the sound.
The color of wine. Formed from 酉, with 弋 indicating the sound.
The color of wine. Formed from 酉, with 巿 indicating the sound.
Drunken excess. Formed from 酉, with 句 indicating the sound.
The explanation is lacking.
To strain wine. Formed from 酉, with 肙 indicating the sound.
Mixed flavors. Formed from 酉, with 京 indicating the sound.
